integrity: The origin of the cubic global-center classification and the general position-dependent mass quadrature are credited; publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed \(a\) real and \(k>a^2\); asymptotic only as \(E\) tends to infinity; no uniform approach to \(k=a^2\) or global monotonicity assertion. Finite numerical checks are illustrative, not proof.
title: Logarithmic occupation and the two-term high-energy period of a cubic global center
